column3: Slow to enter stalls - handy early - hit front 5f out - driven approaching 2f out - responded under pressure inside final furlong to assert
Tracked the pack early - improved into contention 3f out - moved into second approaching 2f out - stayed on into the final furlong finishing 1.25 lengths back in 2nd
Held up in contention - lost ground 3f out - some late progress over 1f out - kept on inside the final furlong to claim third on the line
Settled at the back - pushed along 2f out - made smooth progress into third with a furlong left - unable to threaten leading pair and edged out of third close home
Held up towards the back - driven with two furlongs left but unable to get closer - dropped away in the closing stages to finish fifth
Pulled hard early - set the pace - overtaken past the 5f mark - pushed for a response 3f out - faded in the final furlong to finish sixth
Sat close to front group early - pressed for effort then lost place inside final furlong - eventually held in 7th

Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - handy in the pack and closed on the pacesetter with three furlongs left - roused to go clear inside the final two furlongs - drifted off a true line under pressure a furlong out - stayed on strongly to score

Pulled hard early - settled in the pack - strong progress 3f out - pushed along 2f out - moved into second over 1f out - unable to get to the front runner inside the final furlong - stuck on to finish second
Set the early gallop in front - shaken up and lost the advantage inside the last two furlongs - fought back approaching the final furlong then held steady effort to the line

Sluggish start - settled into midpack shortly after - dropped back when pace quickened 3f from home - pushed along with 2f left then drifted leftward while finding some late run inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish fourth
Tracked the pace early - pushed for effort 3f out - lost ground steadily from 2f out - finished 5th well held
Settled towards the back - pushed along 3f out and made progress despite being squeezed for space approaching the final furlong - stayed on inside to finish sixth
Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back of the pack - stuck for room and eased across a furlong out then unable to close in the last stages
Held up towards the back - pushed along and edged forward approaching 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - eventually finished eighth
Sat close to the pace early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished ninth well behind
Settled at the back early - never got involved - trailed home well beaten in 10th
Held a forward position early - came under pressure and dropped away over 2f out - allowed to drop away steadily inside the final furlong - well held at the finish

Settled just behind the front runners - moved into second before 2f out - closed on the front-runner - roused to hit the front inside the final furlong - eased away in the closing stages to score comfortably
Settled with the pack early - pushed to improve approaching 2f out - moved into second inside the final furlong - stayed on to the line but no answer to the winner
Went straight to the front - pushed along approaching 2f out - overtaken inside the final furlong and dropped to third soon after - unable to find more late and held for the finish
Held up at rear - lost touch with leaders inside final 2f - unable to threaten - finished 4th
Clear early - settled into the pack near the front after a furlong - asked for effort 2f from home - driven but faded inside the final furlong finishing fifth
Bumped at the off - travelling strongly close up - moved left and gained ground with a furlong and a half left - well placed soon after - pushed into command inside the last furlong - won comfortably

Jumped left at the off - corrected right and settled handy - travelling fine with 2f left - pushed along and made ground over 1f out - moved into second inside the final furlong - stayed on well but denied close home
Went straight to the front early - pushed on approaching the final furlong - overtaken and dropped to third close home - unable to find more before the line
Held up in rear - pushed for effort with 2f remaining - never able to challenge in final furlong - finished 4th
Drifted left at the off - settled handy - pushed for effort over 2f out then dropped away inside final furlong
Pulled hard early - up with the pack before easing under pressure over 2f out - drifted left and dropped away inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Settled behind the front pack early - pushed along approaching 2f out - stayed on strongly under pressure into the final furlong - edged ahead close home to prevail
Set the pace early - urged for effort with two furlongs left - driven inside the last - caught close home to finish second
Drifted right at the outset - settled with the pack - held up for space around 2f out - pushed along and made progress inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish third beaten half a length

Dwelt at the start - held up in rear - lost touch and driven approaching 2f out - made gradual progress with much ground to make up entering the last furlong - shifted left and stayed on inside the furlong marker - unable to threaten the leaders - finished fourth
Held up handy in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost touch and dropped away inside the final furlong
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 2f left - driven and faded inside the final furlong - finished sixth

Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - made smooth progress into contention 3f from home - improved into second before 2f out - pushed to the front approaching the final furlong - stayed on strongly to the line

Settled towards rear of field - urged into effort with over 2f remaining - progress gained inside final furlong - moved into second entering last furlong - stayed on to finish second beaten 2 1/4 lengths
Prominent early - pushed along 3f out and made progress 2f out - driven from inside final furlong and stayed on - lacked the speed to land closer than third

Pulled hard early - up near the front - made the running over 5f out - forged well ahead over 4f out - pressure applied from 3f out - rival closed right down over 1f out - overtaken inside the final furlong - faded to finish 4th
Settled in the pack - urged forward 3f out - unable to make headway over 2f out - beaten before the final furlong and finished 5th
Settled in behind leaders early - pushed for effort with 3f remaining - couldn't land a blow - finished sixth beaten 6¾ lengths
Went straight to the front - lost command 5f out and settled behind the pace - pressed for effort 3f out - dropped away steadily in the closing stages to finish 7th
Sluggish start - stuck at the rear and soon adrift - well beaten from 3f out
Set the pace from the start - edged clear approaching final 2f - eased away under light urging near the finish to win comfortably
Handy early - 4th at halfway before improving into 2nd under pressure 2f out - stayed on same gear but unable to reel in winner up the straight
Handy in the early running - disputing second at halfway - driven approaching 3f out - dropped from second and unable to find more inside final 2f - stayed on same rhythm to finish third
Settled in the pack - 8th at halfway - made progress with 4f left - pushed on approaching 2f out - up into 4th inside final furlong before flattening out on the run-in
Settled in the pack - 9th and given encouragement by halfway - finding more approaching 3f out before fading inside the last two furlongs
Settled in the pack - 11th at halfway - driven on approaching 3f out and edged into contention 2f out - lost ground final furlong to finish sixth
Settled in the pack - 6th at halfway - pushed for effort before fading 3f out to finish 7th
Settled in the pack early - 10th at halfway - improved into 6th with 4f left - eased back and finished last
Held handy spot early - third at halfway - dropped away rapidly from 3f out and finished well behind
Settled at the back early - 5th at halfway before dropping away from 6f out - driven and faded 4f out - well beaten in 10th
Settled towards back of field - urged forward before fading with 5f left - finished well beaten in 11th
Settled in the pack - slipped towards the back by halfway - urged on and lost touch 4f out - no response thereafter and well beaten
Held up at back of field - urged forward when isolated near last after 5f - well beaten in 13th
Held up at the back - driven from over 4f out - well beaten at the finish
Never a factor - trailed the field throughout - well beaten in 15th
Settled towards the back of the pack - urged forward but lost touch with 6f remaining - finished well behind
Held a midfield position early - up in 6th at halfway - dropped away rapidly with 5f left and came home well beaten
Shared front spot before going clear at halfway - challenged 2f out - driven approaching final furlong and brushed the rail 100 yards out - stayed on strongly to score
Sat handy behind the front pack - into second and going nicely early in the straight - asked for effort 2f out and battled on inside the last to finish second by half a length
Handy behind the front group early - 4th at halfway then driven approaching final 2f - improved to 3rd but stayed one-paced to the line
Held up towards the back - improved and moved right into 6th 2f out then 5th under a nudge with a furlong left - finished strongly to be beaten 1¾ lengths in 4th
Sat close to the front group early - down in 7th at halfway - up into 4th with 2f left - driven into 3rd a furlong out then flattened out in the closing stages
Held a midfield spot early - asked for effort into the straight but failed to threaten leaders - stayed on at one speed close home to finish sixth
Shared front early - overtaken at halfway - third with 2f left - driven and dropped away soon after finishing seventh
Held up towards the back - made progress early in the straight - driven 2f out and stayed on same speed to the line - finished 8th beaten 7 lengths
Held up towards the back - urged into contention approaching the last two furlongs - stayed on at the same speed without threatening late
Sat close to the front group early - 5th at halfway - dropped to 7th and asked for effort inside final two furlongs before fading out of contention
Settled around midfield - urged for effort entering the straight without gaining ground - held same position to the finish well beaten
Held up towards the back - driven to little effect 2f out - stayed on same gear late without featuring
Settled midfield - pressed for effort with 2f remaining but couldn't land a blow - held no more in reserve - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack early - 6th at halfway - dropped to 8th and asked for effort 2f out - unable to find response and held on late
Held up in the pack early - lost touch through the middle stages - made no impression in the straight - finished well held in 15th
Held up towards the back - pushed along and still behind the pace entering the straight - unable to find more - finished well beaten
Settled in the pack early - keen through the early stages - asked for effort turning into the straight - found nothing more inside final 2f - well held in 17th
Sluggish start before quickly settling into second - shaken up to close in 2f out - driven to the front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to the line

Eager early and up with the front markers - eased back to settle last after the opening furlong - urged along two out - stayed on strongly a furlong out to move into second inside the final furlong - couldn't reel in the winner - finished second beaten a length and a quarter
Tardy start - settled at the back - gradual progress from 3f out - driven over 2f out - moved up to second over 1f out - edged out of that spot inside the final furlong and one-paced to finish third
Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early on - hit the front - drifted right approaching 4f out - driven on with 2f left - overtaken inside the final furlong and faded
Settled third early - pressed for effort with 2f left but couldn't land a blow on the front pair with a furlong to go - stayed on steadily to finish 5th
Handy in third at halfway - moved through wide entering the straight - hit the front before 3 out - full of running to the last - shaken up on the run-in to clear away - won readily
Held up in the rear half - 14th at halfway - progress after 4 out - moved to second before 2 out - one-paced on the run-in and finished 8 lengths back in second
Held handy early - 4th at halfway with errors at the 5th and 7th - driven forward into third before 3 out - stayed on at same rate through the finish to take 3rd

Settled towards the back pulling hard early - mid-division at halfway - had to be niggled at when hampered around 7th - moved smoothly into contention wide out - driven on approaching 3 out - stayed on at one speed to finish fourth

Set the pace early - lost the front before the 4th then fought back into it before the 6th with a stumble there - back in command before the 7th - overtaken and driven up before 3 out where a jump was scrappy - urged on but faded before 2 out - finished well held in 5th
Settled in the pack early - still 11th at halfway - improved into 4th after the 7th - faded before 2 out and held no threat late
Settled midfield - 9th at halfway - improved position after four out - driven up before three out - dropped away after three out and beaten well before the finish
Settled in the pack early - back in 13th at halfway - driven up but lost touch before 3 out - dropped away well beaten in 8th
Held up towards the back - some lengths adrift by halfway - nudged along and edged forward late but always struggling - well beaten at the finish
Settled in midpack - error at 4th - 10th at halfway - urged into effort before fading from 7th - dropped away after 4 out and finished well beaten
Held up at the back - failed to land a blow - dropped away well behind before 4 out - well held at the finish
Held up in the pack - unable to land a blow - well beaten in 12th
Settled in the pack - 5th at halfway - dropped away after 4 out and finished last of all

Up with the front runner - took over before the 4th - matched before the 6th - surrendered the advantage before the 7th - dropped away rapidly and beaten after 4 out before being pulled up before 2 out
Held up towards the back - made no impression on the leading group - stopped before 3 out
Settled in the pack - needed encouragement after the 6th - eased and withdrawn approaching four from home
Settled around midfield - driven for effort after the 6th and lost ground - eased and pulled up before 4 out
Settled in the pack - driven to keep place before fading approaching 7th - eased and pulled up before 3 out
Handy on the wide side early - shared front running 4f out - driven approaching 2f out to edge in front inside the final furlong - kept finding through the last 110yds to prevail

Went forward early but closely challenged - swung wide approaching the bend with 5f left - matched up with 4f to run - driven hard from 2f out - overtaken by a short margin inside final furlong - unable to find more in the closing stages finishing second beaten 1¾ lengths
Tracked the main group early - crept closer by halfway to reach the leading two then driven on approaching 2f out - kept going at a steady effort in the closing stages to finish third
Settled midfield early - improved into fourth 3f out then angled left and driven to bid inside final furlong - unable to add more and held for fourth
Held a midfield position early - urged forward approaching the 3f marker - lost touch inside final 2f - finished 5th
Slow to break - back of the field - driven with 3f left but no impression made - finished sixth
Held up at the back - driven from 3f out - dropped away and finished well beaten in 7th
Settled in the leading pack early - hit the front at halfway before opening up a 3-length advantage with a furlong left - stayed on strongly to score
Sat close to the front group early - into 4th and pushed along 2f out - up to 2nd with a furlong left - stayed on at one gait but couldn't reel in the winner
Held a midfield position early - urged on with 2f left but made little headway inside the final stages - stayed on steadily to snatch 3rd near the line
Settled in the pack early - 5th and asked for effort 2f out - up to 4th and driven with a furlong left before staying on at one speed to finish 4th
Sat close behind the front pack early - up to 3rd and pushed along with 2f left - unable to find more inside the last 150 yards
Hesitant start settling near the back - still 9th with 2f left before improving to 6th under driving inside the final furlong - stayed on at one gear to finish sixth
Settled in midfield - 8th and asked for effort 2f out - couldn't quicken and stayed on same gear to finish 7th
Dwelt at the start and settled towards the back - driven into contention approaching 2f out then 9th with a furlong left - stayed on at one speed to finish 8th
Front early - second with 2f left - pressed for more inside final furlong then dropped away to finish 9th
Held up handy early - 7th and driven 2f out - unable to find more - well held in 10th
Held up at the back throughout - driven inside final 2f without threatening leaders - held on same pace to finish 11th
Set the pace from the start - pushed on approaching final furlong before edging away inside it - crossed the line without a rival in sight
Sat in behind the pace - urged forward approaching 2f out - stayed on from inside the final furlong - unable to challenge the winner - finished second
Settled at the rear early - improved into third with 3f left - pushed along but unable to trouble the leading pair inside the final 2f - finished third
Sat close to front two early - lost touch and fell to rear approaching 3f out - well behind entering final furlong - finished well held in 4th

Shared the front early - moved clear before the 3rd then headed once more approaching four out - travelling strongest before three out - opened a three length advantage there - driven out approaching the last - responded gamely to hold on through the finish
Settled in the pack - untidy at the 1st - 11th at halfway - moved through to fifth after 4 out - pushed up to second before 2 out - kept on without troubling the winner

Shared front early - slipped to third before the 3rd - up to second at halfway - regained a share up front 4 out - overtaken and driven on after 3 out - gave way before 2 out and had nothing left approaching the last
Settled in the pack - 7th at halfway - bumped after the 6th - stumbled 4 out - found some late progress under driving before 4 out - lost touch before 2 out and finished well beaten
Up with the front group early - error at 6th - third at halfway - pressed after 4 out but faded before 3 out - eventually well held
Settled in the pack - checked briefly 6th - up to 9th by halfway - improved into 5th after 4 out - dropped away before 3 out and finished well beaten
Settled in the pack early - bumped 6th - 10th at halfway - driven before fading after 4 out and well beaten at the finish
Towards the back of the chasing group - nudged for momentum at halfway - seriously hampered after the 6th - made some ground after 4 out before dropping away before 3 out - well behind at the finish
Held up towards the back - stumbled at the 3rd - hampered by a loose horse after the 6th - never able to get back into it and well beaten
Sat close to front early - 5th at halfway - stumbled 4 out - lost touch rapidly thereafter and finished well beaten
Held up towards the back - suffered a heavy bump from a loose horse after the 6th and never regained pace - beaten a long way home
Held a forward spot early on the outer - into 9th and pressed for a spell around halfway - checked in traffic after the 6th - dropped away soon after - finished well beaten
Held up towards the back - seriously hindered by a loose horse after the 6th - never able to get back on terms and well beaten from there
Held up towards the back - mistake at 5th - seriously baulked by a loose horse next - unable to get back into contention and dropped away - pulled up before 3 out
Settled at the back early - driven approaching halfway and dropping away before the 6th - eased out of contention before 3 out
Settled around midfield out wide - 6th at halfway - came down at the sixth
Held a forward position early but not jumping cleanly - still 4th at halfway after an error 6th - then a heavy blunder 4 out - faded fast under pressure - eased to a halt approaching 3 out
Settled towards the back of the pack - urged forward around halfway - lost ground after the 6th - eased and pulled up before 3 out

Went in front early - lost advantage by a whisker 2f out and pushed along - fought back to edge back in charge inside the final furlong and a half - held on under renewed pressure late - won by the smallest of margins
Up with the first two - driven over 2f out - moved left and urged - ran on strongly in the final furlong - challenged for the lead late but went down by a short head
Sat close up early - urged into contention before 2f out and edged in front - overtaken close home - unable to find more finished third
Held up towards the back - driven up before 3f out - unable to challenge - finished fourth beaten 3.5 lengths
Settled at the back - niggled into contention from 3f out - never competitive and finished 5th
Sat behind the front pair - third turning for home - asked for effort over 2f out - stayed on strongly to hit the front in the final strides
Set the pace early - lost front spot approaching halfway - chased in second and asked for effort over 2f out - regained advantage inside the final furlong before losing out in the closing strides
Driven early up with front-runner - moved into command shortly before halfway - urged on with 2f left and driven out inside final furlong - overtaken close home and unable to fight back for third
Held up towards the back of the pack early - urged into 6th 2f out then improved to 5th under pressure inside final furlong - finished strongly close home to take 4th beaten a length and a quarter
Sat close to the front pack early - 4th at halfway - urged forward with two furlongs left - stayed on same gear to finish fifth
Settled midfield - 7th at halfway - asked for effort 2f out - up to 6th inside final furlong but only stayed on same rate to finish sixth
Settled towards the back - urged forward with no response 2f out - stayed on at one gear through the final furlong to finish seventh
Settled in midpack early - keen but under control - 5th at halfway - urged on approaching 2f out - dropped to 7th with a shake-up 1f out and unable to find more - beaten into 8th
Settled in the pack - 6th at halfway - pushed along over 2f out but unable to close and finished without response
Held up towards the back - asked for effort but made no dent on the front two out - couldn't quicken final furlong - finished tenth
Sluggish break - stayed towards the back of the field - pushed along with no headway entering straight - unable to find more late - beaten well over 12 lengths in 11th
Settled close to the front group early - moved through around 2f out - into second inside the final furlong - kept battling and got up close home
Knocked at the off - settled second early - hit the front a furlong out - pushed along and caught close home to just miss out
Stumbled and knocked about at the break - settled handy with the pace early - lost ground over a furlong out - fought back inside the final furlong to close and edge into third close home
Settled towards the back early - made ground into contention a furlong out and pressed the front two - faded close home to finish fourth
Went straight to the front - driven and lost command approaching final furlong - faded fast and drifted off the pack close home
Settled in the pack early - still around 5th at halfway - moved left approaching two out - driven on soon after - drew level at the final flight - kicked clear on the run-in for a clear-cut success
Set the pace early - matched at halfway then clear again after the 6th - pressed for effort approaching 2 out - challenged close home - overtaken and unable to fight back - stayed on for second
Settled in the pack early - up to third by halfway and second when a rival departed the field - driven from three out - handed back a place approaching the last - stayed on steadily to finish third
Held up towards the back of the pack - 9th at halfway - made progress before 3 out - pushed on into contention then hit the second-last awkwardly - kept going for fourth on the run-in
Held up at the back - improved on the inner before 3 out - driven from there - stayed on same pace up the run-in
Settled towards the back early - some way off the pace by halfway - improved into 7th approaching 3 out - driven from there - stumbled 2 out - unable to find more and finished sixth
Settled in the pack - 6th at halfway - improved into 4th before 3 out - pressed but couldn't quicken - lost touch before the last and faded to finish 7th
Held up towards the back - driven into contention approaching 3 out - moved right before 2 out then pressed for the finish - held no further response and beaten well into 8th
Held up towards the back of the pack - clumsy at the first - 11th at halfway - driven and went wide approaching 3 out - dropped away soon after and never a factor
Held up in the pack - 8th at halfway - driven approaching 3 out - blundered there - lost touch before 2 out and beaten well
Held up in the pack - urged forward before 3 out - lost touch after and beaten off through to the line
Settled in midfield - 7th at halfway after a brief bump in 6th - driven up before 3 out - faded rapidly after that - stumbled 2 out - unable to threaten leaders late
Near the front early - up in 4th at halfway - knocked off stride past the 6th - dropped away before 3 out and finished well beaten
Held a midfield spot early - slipped towards the back by halfway - driven for effort after four out but soon lost touch before three out - finished well adrift in 14th
Settled behind the pace - improved to press the front around halfway - came down at the 6th
Settled close to the front - lost touch in a hurry before halfway - eased and pulled up before the 5th
Set the pace from the start - given a shake up 2f out under company pressure - driven approaching the final furlong - kept finding late to forge clear close home
Handy in second early - driven approaching final 2f - battled on well - flattened out inside final furlong to finish second beaten 1¾ lengths
Sat close to the pace early - urged forward before halfway - driven with 2f remaining - kept on to finish third without landing a real blow
Sat close to the front group - urged forward around halfway - asked for effort 2f out but failed to land a blow then hampered a touch late on
Slow to break - settled at the back - shifted wide and driven on with 2f left - kept on late without threatening the front
Held up at the back - driven approaching final 2f - unable to close - finished sixth
midfield early - driven from over 2f out - dropped away to finish seventh
Asked for effort early and soon hit the front - opened a two length margin over a furlong out - driven out and battled on to the line for a narrow win
Settled in the pack early - still 9th at halfway - angled right and asked for effort over 2f out - up to 8th under pressure inside final furlong - finished strongly but denied by a short margin

Sat handy behind front group - 5th at halfway - driven to improve on the inside approaching 2f out to lead the chasing pack - into 2nd and driven out with a furlong left - held the effort to the line for third
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along and unable to make headway wide out approaching 2f out - stayed on strongly through the last furlong to close best of all
Sat behind the front group - 4th at halfway - driven approaching 2f out - into 3rd inside final furlong but unable to close in the closing stages
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along with no headway a furlong and a half out - responded to finish strongest of all late on
Settled in the pack - urged into 6th 2f out then improved to 4th with a furlong left - flattened out under pressure inside final 150 yards to finish 7th
Sat close up early - third at halfway - shifted right approaching 2f out then fifth and pressed for effort inside final furlong - unable to find more before the line
Held up towards the back - asked for effort 2f out - denied a clean route with 1f left - stayed on at the same rate through a gap late - finished 9th beaten 3.5 lengths
Settled in the pack - 6th at halfway - driven approaching 2f out and dropped to 7th inside final furlong - unable to close and finished 10th
Hesitant start and urged forward - settled towards the back of the field - asked for effort on the inner with two furlongs left then stayed on at one gear through the final furlong
Sat close to the pace early - 7th at halfway - moved right and pushed along over 2f out - unable to find headway through the closing stages
Held up towards back of the pack - urged into contention but made no headway with 2f left - couldn't find more from over 1f out - well held in 13th
Held up towards the back - driven approaching 2f out with little response - unable to quicken inside final furlong - well held at the finish
Sluggish to begin and driven up early - stayed at the back of the field throughout - made no impression on the finish
Sat close to the pace - up in 2nd at halfway - driven 2f out then dropped away inside the final furlong with nothing left to offer

Settled with the front group early - asked for effort 2f out - gained ground fast approaching the furlong pole - hit the front close home under pressure - fought off a late rally to prevail by a whisker
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - urged along with 2f left - made smooth progress from 1f out - angled left to challenge in the closing stages and edged narrowly beaten
Handy early - hit front approaching final furlong under a squeeze - overtaken inside last - unable to find more and edged out for third close home
Handy in the pack - pushed for effort inside final 2f - lost ground steadily to the line - finished 4th
Sat up behind the front rank early - edged left under pressure a furlong out - unable to land a blow inside final furlong finishing fifth
Set the pace early - pushed on before giving way over 1f out - dropped away through the final furlong to finish 6th
Held up towards the back - dropped away and lost touch over 2f out - well beaten at the finish

Set the pace from the off - keen through early stages with a stumble before the 2nd - another error at the 4th - going ominously well from 3 out - driven approaching 2 out - clear before the last then stumbled there - responded well to the whip and held on up the run-in for victory
Handy early - second at halfway - stumbled 5th and again 4 out - driven from 3 out - untidy at 2 out - responded and stayed on to finish second beaten 3 lengths
Handy in the early stages - 4th at halfway - given encouragement approaching 3 out - lost touch and lacked pace before 2 out - finished well to grab 3rd close home
Sat close to the front - third at halfway - urged forward approaching 3 out - driven with 2 to go - slightly awkward at last - stayed on at same rate to finish and edged out for third at the line

Settled towards the back early - stumbled first - travelled keenly - improved into 11th by halfway - moved through before three out - driven on after that - stumbled two out then stayed on at one speed to the line
Settled midfield - 6th at halfway - given a nudge before 3 out - driven approaching 2 out - lost touch late and finished 6th
Held up towards the back of the pack - 8th at halfway - urged into contention after 4 out - lost touch before 3 out and beaten well
Settled midfield early - 7th at halfway - driven approaching 3 out but found little more - lost ground on the run-in to finish well held
Settled towards the back - bumped a little at the 5th - driven on after four out and improved into it before three out - always held well behind the front rank - finished ninth beaten 20½ lengths
Held up in the pack - still 10th at halfway - urged into action after four out - blundered three out - faded from there and beaten well before two out
Settled in the pack - held 5th at halfway - blundered 4 out - pushed for effort before 3 out and hit that flight awkwardly - dropped away before 2 out - finished well beaten in 11th
Towards the rear of the field - 9th at halfway - urged forward approaching 3 out - effort faded before the last and finished well held
Settled midfield early - bumped mildly 4th - lost ground into the second half - faded from contention after 4 out and finished well beaten
Held up towards the back of the pack - came down at the 4th
Settled midfield early - keen through the pace before losing touch by halfway - came down at the 5th
Held up at the back - errors at the 6th saw the partnership momentarily galvanised - beaten off before 4 out and pulled up approaching 3 out having become detached
took hold early - led throughout despite pressure - pulled out more from 1f out and quickened - won with something to spare

Held a forward spot on the wide side - urged into contention over 1f out - moved into second drifting left inside the final furlong - kept responding to the line but unable to overhaul the winner - finished second
Sat close to the leading group early - asked for effort 2f out - stayed on at one tempo to finish third
Handy behind front pack early - driven approaching 2f out - weakened final furlong to finish 4th
Sat close to front early - urged on with over 2f left then edged back approaching final furlong - hampered soon after and faded to finish fifth
Sat close up on the far flank early - third with 2f remaining - second and driven a furlong out - surged clear inside the final 100 yards to prevail
Held a forward spot on the far rail - disputed second at halfway - pushed along to hit the front a furlong out - overtaken close home and unable to fight back
Settled in the pack down the middle - driven to improve into contention with 2f left and up to 4th a furlong out - finished strongly to take 3rd
Settled midfield through the pack early - improved to 4th by halfway then eased to 5th and pressed a furlong out - stayed on same gear to finish 4th
Held a midfield spot on the far flank early - asked for effort with 2f left and up in 7th at the furlong marker - stayed on at one speed to finish fifth beaten 4.5 lengths
